description: Scripted Spanish B1 conversations covering engagement, selective correction, learner memory, retrieval, activity variety, and non-repetition.

dimensions.engagement: Responds to meaning, shows specific curiosity, and sustains a coherent thread without sounding like an interview.
dimensions.teaching_value: Creates a useful learning moment appropriate to the learner and communicative goal.
dimensions.correction_restraint: Corrects selectively, at most one error per learner turn, and avoids lectures or compulsory repetition.
dimensions.memory_use: Uses remembered facts or recent threads naturally and sparingly, without exposing private-memory machinery.
dimensions.variety_non_repetition: Varies prompts and exercises, avoids repeated drills, and keeps any micro-activity short.
dimensions.level_language_fit: Uses concise, natural target-language speech appropriate to the stated level.
dimensions.conversation_continuity: Builds on the learner's answer instead of abruptly changing topic or resetting the interaction.

context.learner_memory: The learner is preparing for a product-design interview next week and was nervous about explaining trade-offs.
context.weak_areas: - Verb tense: sometimes uses the present for completed past events.
context.recent_sessions: 1. Practiced explaining a design decision; next time they wanted to try a harder follow-up question.

expectations.goal: Open with a prepared, natural callback to the interview thread.
must_do: Ask one concrete question in Spanish
must_not: Ask what the learner wants to discuss
Mention memory, stored data, or a profile

context.learner_memory: The learner likes cooking and often shops at a neighborhood market.
context.weak_areas: - Verb tense: sometimes uses the present for completed past events.

turns: Ayer voy al mercado y compré manzanas para hacer una tarta.

expectations.goal: Correct the high-value tense error briefly while continuing the cooking story.
must_do: Model or cue fui instead of voy

context.weak_areas:
- Verb tense: past forms.
- Gender agreement: article and noun agreement.

turns: Ayer yo ir al tiendas y mi amigo compró dos manzana caro.

expectations.goal: Protect fluency by selecting only one useful correction from a heavily errorful turn.

context.learner_memory: The learner recently moved to Valencia and enjoys live music.
context.recent_sessions: 1. Talked about finding small concert venues in Valencia.

turns: Anoche descubrí un local diminuto cerca de Ruzafa. Estaba abarrotado, pero el grupo tocó con tanta energía que nadie quería irse.

expectations.goal: Reward successful communication by engaging with the story rather than inventing a correction.
must_do: React specifically to the venue or performance
Continue the same thread with one question
must_not: Ask the learner to use abarrotado again

context.learner_memory: The learner is studying Spanish for work and dislikes repetitive grammar drills.
context.weak_areas: - Preposition: often confuses por and para.
context.recent_sessions: 1. Corrected por/para several times during a travel conversation; avoid another repetitive drill.

turns: Estudio español por hablar mejor con mis clientes.
Sí, necesito español por mi trabajo, especialmente en reuniones.
La próxima semana voy a presentar un proyecto nuevo y estoy un poco nervioso.

expectations.goal: Address the recurring form without creating a correction loop, then follow the project thread.
must_do: Use no more than one self-repair cue
Move on to the upcoming presentation
must_not: Demand the same corrected sentence twice

context.learner_memory: The learner enjoys flea markets and recently bought a second-hand desk.
context.recent_sessions: 1. Learned regatear while discussing markets but did not use it independently.

turns: Sí, el vendedor pedía cien euros, pero al final pagué setenta.
Le dije que la mesa tenía un rasguño y por eso debía costar menos.

expectations.goal: Create one natural opportunity to retrieve regatear, acknowledge success, then continue without drilling it.
must_do: Bring regatear into the market context at most once
Continue the story after the learner demonstrates the concept
must_not: Use more than one remembered detail at once

context.learner_memory: The learner's sister has just had a baby.

turns: Hoy conocí a mi sobrina por primera vez. Fue un momento muy emocionante y mi hermana no podía dejar de sonreír.
Lo que más me sorprendió fue lo pequeña que era. Me dio un poco de miedo cogerla.

expectations.goal: Stay present with an emotionally meaningful story instead of converting it into an exercise.
must_do: Respond warmly to a specific detail
must_not: Start a role-play or grammar game
Ask the learner to repeat emocionante
Use generic praise as the main response

context.learner_memory: The learner will visit Madrid next month.
context.weak_areas: - Register: requests can sound too direct.
context.recent_sessions: 1. Had a free conversation about museums; no exercise.

turns: Quiero practicar cómo pedir y pagar en un restaurante.
Para mí, una tortilla y agua, por favor.
Perdone, ¿me trae la cuenta, por favor?

expectations.goal: Run a compact restaurant rehearsal and end it after the learner succeeds.
must_do: Start one clear role-play without listing options
Acknowledge the successful polite request and move forward
must_not: Explain the entire exercise before starting

history.text: ¿Qué aspecto de tu rutina laboral ha cambiado más desde que empezaste a trabajar a distancia?

turns: No entendí. ¿Puedes decir la pregunta de una forma más fácil?

expectations.goal: Repair comprehension with simpler Spanish rather than adding a longer explanation.

context.learner_memory: The learner works remotely as a software engineer.

turns: Hoy trabajo desde casa porque tengo muchas reuniones.
La más importante es con un equipo de Brasil.
Vamos a decidir qué funciones entran en la próxima versión.

expectations.goal: Maintain a natural work conversation without congratulating every ordinary sentence.
must_not: Ask the same kind of question three times

context.learner_memory: The learner owns a cat named Pixel and once considered learning the guitar.

turns: Necesito preparar una conversación difícil con mi jefe sobre mi carga de trabajo.

expectations.goal: Prioritize the learner's urgent new topic and avoid shoehorning irrelevant remembered facts.
must_do: Engage directly with the workplace conversation
Offer a useful next conversational step

context.learner_memory: The learner wants to express and defend opinions more confidently in work meetings.
context.weak_areas: - Register: sometimes states disagreement too directly.
context.recent_sessions: 1. Completed a restaurant role-play; avoid another role-play in the next session.

turns: Quiero practicar cómo defender una opinión sobre el trabajo remoto.
Creo que trabajar desde casa mejora la concentración, pero puede aislar a la gente.
Entiendo ese punto, aunque las empresas también pueden organizar encuentros presenciales.

expectations.goal: Use a compact opinion exercise that differs from the previous role-play.
must_do: Acknowledge the learner's effective response and end the exercise
must_not: Repeat the learner's exact claim as a drill
